entry.title: No. 4
entry.summaryHtml: Cocoa, espresso, cedar, earth, cream, toasted nuts and pepper define the classic Montecristo profile in a compact 42-ring Marevas. The smoke is typically medium to medium-full, with coffee and cocoa building through the middle and darker roast, leather and pepper becoming more noticeable late.
entry.noteHtml: The No. 4 is the flagship Marevas expression of Montecristo’s traditional blend: fuller and more substantial than the Shorts while retaining the same core coffee, cocoa, cedar and earthy character. Construction is often excellent, but tight rolls and uneven burns appear often enough in owner reports to justify a Yellow construction-risk flag.
